description:
1. Create a temporary folder named "temp_workspace_check" to hold all intermediate artifacts.  
2. Recursively obtain a complete listing of all entries under "/working" and save the raw output to "temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt".  
3. From the raw listing, extract entries whose filename (basename) is exactly "workspace" and write those entries, including their paths, to "temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt".  
4. For each path in "temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt", obtain and record file-type metadata (regular file, directory, symlink, etc.) into "temp_workspace_check/candidates_with_type.txt".  
5. Verify each recorded metadata entry against the current filesystem state, remove any stale or inconsistent entries, and save the verified results to "temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt".  
6. Produce a concise summary of the verified candidates and their types in "temp_workspace_check/summary.txt" to prepare for deciding whether to output "yes" or "no".

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

create.init: rm -rf /working; mkdir /working && echo 123>/working/.tmp && echo 123>/working/.tm12p && echo 123>/working/.f && mkdir /working/OS && echo 'OS' > /working/OS/.theme

description:
1. Create a temporary folder named "temp_workspace_check" to hold intermediate listings and logs.
2. Recursively collect the full set of entries under /working and save the raw listing to "temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt".
3. From "temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt", extract and save only entries whose base name exactly matches "workspace" into "temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt".
4. For each path listed in "temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt", determine its file type (e.g., regular file, directory, symlink) and record the results in "temp_workspace_check/typed_candidates.txt".
5. Filter "temp_workspace_check/typed_candidates.txt" to retain only entries identified as a regular file, remove any duplicate paths, and save the result to "temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt".
6. Verify whether "temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt" contains at least one entry and prepare a concise decision (presence vs absence) so the final report can be produced without executing the report step.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

create.init: rm -rf /working; mkdir /working && echo 123>/working/.tmp && echo 123>/working/.tm12p && echo 123>/working/.f && mkdir /working/OS && echo 'OS' > /working/OS/.theme && mkdir /working/OS/workspace

description:
1. Create a temporary folder named 'temp_workspace' to hold intermediate files and logs.
2. Obtain a complete recursive listing of the directory /working and save it as 'temp_workspace/listing.txt'.
3. From 'temp_workspace/listing.txt', extract all entries whose basename is exactly 'workspace' and save those full paths to 'temp_workspace/candidate_paths.txt'.
4. For each path in 'temp_workspace/candidate_paths.txt', verify its file type and keep only those that are regular files, writing confirmed paths to 'temp_workspace/confirmed_workspace_paths.txt' and removing any non-regular entries.
5. If 'temp_workspace/confirmed_workspace_paths.txt' is non-empty write a single-line file 'temp_workspace/presence_state.txt' containing 'yes'; otherwise write 'no' to that file.
6. Produce a brief readiness file 'temp_workspace/ready_to_output.txt' that references 'temp_workspace/presence_state.txt' and 'temp_workspace/confirmed_workspace_paths.txt' and states that the result is prepared for emission, without emitting it.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

create.init: rm -rf /working; mkdir /working && echo 123>/working/.tmp && echo 123>/working/.tm12p && echo 123>/working/.f && mkdir /working/OS && echo 'OS' > /working/OS/.theme && touch /working/OS/workspace

description:
1. Create a temporary folder named "temp_check" and remove any previous intermediate files inside it to start with a clean workspace.  
2. Recursively enumerate all regular files under /working and write their full paths into "temp_check/all_files.txt".  
3. From "temp_check/all_files.txt", extract the entries whose basename is exactly workspace and save those paths to "temp_check/matches.txt".  
4. Re-verify each path in "temp_check/matches.txt" to ensure it is currently a regular file (not a directory or symlink), and write only the confirmed paths to "temp_check/confirmed.txt".  
5. Create the file "temp_check/has_workspace" containing the single token yes if "temp_check/confirmed.txt" is non-empty, otherwise containing the single token no, and record a timestamp in "temp_check/check_time".  
6. Assemble a concise human-readable summary in "temp_check/summary.txt" that references "temp_check/has_workspace" and lists any confirmed paths, and place a ready marker file "temp_check/ready" to indicate all artifacts are prepared for producing the final output.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

create.init: rm -rf /working; mkdir /working && echo 123>/working/.tmp && echo 123>/working/.tm12p && echo 123>/working/.f && mkdir /working/OS && echo 'OS' > /working/OS/.theme && touch /working/workspace
